Radio Free Asia FAQ

What frequency is Radio Free Asia on?
In the A-26 season Radio Free Asia is scheduled on 8 shortwave frequencies, including 9320, 9370, 9405, 9600, 9900, 9915 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9320 kHz (9 pm – 9:30 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9320 kHz (2 am – 2:30 am UTC+1).

Can I hear Radio Free Asia in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9320 kHz (9 pm – 9:30 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Radio Free Asia broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. Radio Free Asia is scheduled in Tibetan, Korean, Khmer.

Is Radio Free Asia on the air right now?
As of Saturday, September 26, 2026, 09:51 UTC, Radio Free Asia is not currently scheduled to be broadcasting. Next scheduled transmission is 11885 kHz at 12:30 UTC. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
